waive.tiny-text: Deliberate instrument-panel grammar: 9-11px uppercase micro-labels keep 25-point histories and three modality cards on one SCADA screen. Confirmed by visual critique as the dashboard's strongest consistent element; raising them globally breaks the grid.
waive.small-body: This is a dense telemetry instrument panel, not a prose page. Body copy is composed of short status strings and labels; 16px body text would overflow the single-screen layout used on the exhibition display.
waive.long-lines: The measured ~123-character line is the hardware/RTDB utility string in the header/footer, not article prose. It is a fixed device path and cannot be shortened without losing the Firebase endpoint shown to operators.
waive.default-font: Inter + JetBrains Mono is the established type system across index.html, guide.html and calibration.html. Changing it only on the dashboard would break visual consistency with the rest of the capstone site.
waive.too-many-fonts: KaTeX injects KaTeX_Main and math for displayed equations; the authored faces are Oxanium and JetBrains Mono, with Arial only as a fallback. Removing KaTeX would remove the procedure equations.
